in_marathi.name: Somveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Somveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Somveer is a combination of two Sanskrit words, ‘Som’ and ‘Veer’. ‘Som’ refers to Lord Shiva, the God of the Universe, and ‘Veer’ means brave or strong. Thus, Somveer is the name of the Lord of the Universe, who is believed to be the source of all strength and courage.
